definition: A grid holding the coefficients of each equation in a linear system, one row per equation, with the right-hand sides in a final column after a bar.
The staircase shape of an augmented matrix in which each row's first non-zero entry lies to the right of the one in the row above, with any rows of zeros last, ready for back-substitution.
A system of equations with no solution; row reduction gives a row that says $0 = c$ with $c \neq 0$.
Every solution of a linear system with infinitely many solutions, written with each unknown in terms of a parameter such as $\lambda$.
